text:
Tom H: Quick prep for Newbridge POC. They want streaming + function/tool calls returning strict JSON (they'll run schema validation), EU residency, CMK KMS. Commercial asked for a one-line procurement anchor for ~20 concurrent streams at ~3k tokens/request and burst to 40.

Sofia L: I'll handle procurement language. Need a clear sentence for "where data stays" for Dedicated vs Private we can paste in the SOW.

Miguel (SE): Integration notes: we support websocket and gRPC streaming. Default SDK buffers until function_call.complete, but you can enable incremental payloads with options.partial_tool_payload=true. Example (Node):

Miguel (SE): ```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'start', model: 'redwood-stream-1', options: { partial_tool_payload: true, schema: 'org:newbridge:invoice-v1' } })));
ws.on('message', raw => { const m = JSON.parse(raw); console.log(m.type, m.delta); });
```

Miguel (SE): Also note: we offer a schema-registry header so the runtime validates emitted tool output against a registered schema and surfaces a structured error if it doesn't match. If they need early-action on partial args, set partial_tool_payload and run progressive validation on deltas.

Priya V: Security boilerplate draft: "Dedicated: inference runs in reserved Redwood cluster in customer's selected region (EU available). Private: deploys into customer's VPC/on-prem so payloads do not leave customer network. We support customer-managed keys (CMK) via cloud KMS and on-prem HSMs. SOC2/ISO artifacts available under NDA." I'll confirm exact EU region names with infra.

Tom H: Pricing/commercial ask: does streaming change token billing? And rough Dedicated sizing for steady 20x3k tokens, with spikes to 40? They want a number to include in procurement.

Miguel (SE): Tokens billed the same. Dedicated reduces effective compute cost via batching and KV prefix caching. Rough pilot anchor: reserve capacity to cover 20 steady concurrent contexts for medium model -> estimate 3 GPU-equivalents reserved + autoscale burst pool (1-2 units) to cover spikes to 40. Recommend quick 2-hour load test (20x3k steady + brief spike) to validate GPU-hours.

Sofia L: Draft procurement line: "1-month Dedicated pilot: 30% pilot credit applied to first month (up to 200 GPU-hours). Reserved capacity sized to support 20 concurrent 3k-token streams; autoscale configured for bursts. Overage billed at standard Dedicated rates; subject to legal." Is that copyable?

Priya V: Yes, and I'll append: "Data residency and CMK options documented; audit artifacts available under NDA."

Tom H: Can SDK emit partial tool payloads as independent events (i.e., not reassembled)? Newbridge might want each partial as a webhook callback.

Miguel (SE): We can stream deltas as independent events. For webhooks you can forward deltas to a callback endpoint; recommend adding a short debounce to avoid overwhelming downstream. Also we support gRPC multiplexing if they want fewer concurrent connections.

OpsBot: Runbook created: runbook://newbridge-poc-1717123456 (access: sales,se,security,infra).

Sofia L: Action items: (1) Priya finalize questionnaire + SOC2 link, (2) Miguel post Node+Go snippets + mini load harness, (3) Tom draft kickoff invite (30m Tue 10am CET), (4) Sofia send procurement anchor to legal/finance.

Miguel (SE): I'll drop Go snippet and the harness by EOD and open a quick eng-ml job for the 2-hour run. If infra needs warm-pool lead time for EU, flag it here.

Priya V: Looping infra for region naming/lead time now.

Tom H: Thanks all—I'll assemble the kickoff packet and include this thread.

Sofia L: :+1: I'll post the finalized procurement line once Finance confirms.
